pages.text: A silo 3 wide, 3 deep and 4 to 8 tall. Every block that is not a fitting is a $(bold)Superconducting Cell$(), corners and centre included. Taller holds more. Every part is crafted.

pages.title: Fittings
pages.text: Four kinds of fitting.$(li)$(bold)Controller$(): bottom of the front middle. It sets the front.$(li)$(bold)Quench Vent$(): top centre.$(li)$(bold)Cryocooler$(): at least one, bottom row, sides or back.$(li)$(bold)Port$(): at least one, any side, never the front middle column.

pages.title: Forming
pages.text: Use the Controller to see whether it formed, and if not, why. Once formed the cells join into one black hull with a gauge window up the front.

pages.title: Superconducting Cell
pages.text: Makes two. A silo takes 32 to 68.

pages.title: Port
pages.text: A Large Power Relay with a gold contact.
